confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, beer and cocktail anchors rest on 2026 aggregated Athens cost-of-living and travel-guide sources, not an official price survey. Most were EUR-quoted and translated at an approximate, unsourced EUR/USD assumption. Beer is a ~0.5 L domestic draught. Cocktail and wine rest on guide ranges rather than venue checks and were cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.4x beer); wine is the weakest food anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic, knowledge-based July estimates; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked. Outlier figures from one March 2026 aggregator (about $8 inexpensive meal, about $24 mid-range meal for two) conflicted with other sources and were excluded. FX is NOT the latest observation for 2026-11-19: the single RBA search returned only a search-index snapshot of the RBA exchange-rate page with rates through 2026-03-20, not confirmed by a live page read, and no retry was made. A later third-party figure could not be checked against rba.gov.au and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution was used for food and drink, which relies on Athens-specific aggregated sources. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates of July peak-season Athens pricing from general knowledge, informed loosely by other large southern European capitals with similar summer demand.
